# Currents News API

> Real-time news API with a large historical article index, broad monitored source catalog, and 34 languages. Developer-friendly JSON with monitored production reliability and a free tier.

## Overview

Currents News API provides structured news data via REST endpoints. New articles are indexed daily from a source directory of 12,000+ source entries assigned to 168 country designations.

## Pricing

- Free: 250 requests/day (resets 00:00 UTC), 20 results/request, 30-day lookback, 7-day max date span per search, 300-character text preview
- Builder: $69/mo — 2,500 requests/day enforced daily (75K/mo billing allowance), 50 results/request, 6-month archive, 31-day max date span per search
- Professional: $150/mo — 10,000 requests/day enforced daily (300K/mo billing allowance), 100 results/request, 1-year archive, 90-day max date span per search
- Scale: $300/mo — 20,000 requests/day enforced daily (600K/mo billing allowance), 200 results/request, 1-year archive, 180-day max date span per search
- Daily caps reset at 00:00 UTC; unused daily volume does not roll over; exceeding a cap returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After — no overage billing
- Languages: 34 on every plan (GET /v1/available/languages, checked 2026-10-27)
